name: twz-fire-system-root
description: Root workspace — runs all microservices + frontend concurrently

scripts.setup: npm run db:create && npm run seed
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --prefix-colors "bgRed,bgGreen,bgYellow,bgBlue,bgMagenta,bgCyan,white" --names "GATEWAY,USER,EQUIP,INSP,REPORT,NOTIFY,FRONTEND" "npm run dev --prefix api-gateway" "npm run dev --prefix services/user-service" "npm run dev --prefix services/equipment-service" "npm run dev --prefix services/inspection-service" "npm run dev --prefix services/report-service" "npm run dev --prefix services/notification-service" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names "GATEWAY,USER,EQUIPMENT,INSPECTION,REPORT,NOTIFY,FRONTEND" "npm start --prefix api-gateway" "npm start --prefix services/user-service" "npm start --prefix services/equipment-service" "npm start --prefix services/inspection-service" "npm start --prefix services/report-service" "npm start --prefix services/notification-service" "npm run preview --prefix frontend"
